name: godot-accel
description: A process layer for running a Godot 4 game project with Claude Code: sessions, docs, decisions, memory and checks.

plugins.name: godot-accel
plugins.description: Bootstrap a Godot project's CLAUDE.md, rules and docs, then run it session by session: resume, plan, check, save, trim, audit.

plugins.name: godot-sourcing
plugins.description: Find or build, your call: before Claude makes a shader, model, texture, sky, addon or system, it asks whether to find a ready-made one or build it. Finding shortlists free, licence-checked options, fetches your pick and records the credit.
